tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.description: A one-call brief on an airport's car hire market this morning. Per car type: the typical daily rate, the cheapest and dearest pick-up days in the next 14 and the gap between them, and weekend against weekday. Plus the number of brands, the best-rated and lowest-priced brands, and events and holidays

tools.name: get_promotion_days
tools.description: For campaign planning: each of the next 14 pick-up days at an airport ranked against the window for a car type. tools.name: get_brand_position
tools.description: One brand's position at an airport this morning: its price index and rank on price, share of days it has the cheapest offer, customer rating and rank, each rating sub-score against the airport average, depot type, the rivals priced closest to it, and the brands that are rated higher while priced low

tools.name: list_airports
tools.description: The 38 airports Rate Pulse covers (code, city, country, currency, region) and the date of the latest morning sweep.

tools.name: get_market_rates
tools.description: The car hire market at one airport this morning: for each car type and each of the next 14 pick-up days, the cheapest, lower-quartile and median (typical) advertised daily rate and the number of offers.

tools.name: get_brand_rates
tools.description: Each rental brand at an airport this morning: price index vs market, share of days it's cheapest, median and cheapest daily rate per car type and pick-up day, customer rating with sub-scores, depot (in terminal, shuttle, distance), free-cancellation and automatic share.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Events (concerts, sport, conferences, festivals, with venue, expected attendance and when our research first saw them) and public and school holidays for an airport's city and country over a date range. Default: today to 90 days ahead.

tools.name: compare_airports
tools.description: One car type across all (or chosen) airports this morning: median and cheapest daily rate over the next 14 pick-up days in NZD and local currency, and offer depth.

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Customer ratings for every brand at an airport (overall and sub-scores: value for money, collection time, condition, cleanliness and more, with review counts) next to each brand's price index.

tools.name: about_rate_pulse
tools.description: How Rate Pulse collects and calculates its numbers, what each field means, what's covered, and what the free and Pro plans include.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_brand_position, get_ratings · Public sink: get_brand_position, get_brand_rates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_brand_position, get_ratings · Public sink: get_brand_position, get_brand_rates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
